model.name: Lobby room-list uses ONE owner-aware builder emitted AFTER auth — a private owned room appears in EVERY room-list (no pre-auth owner-unaware welcome that flaps the list)
model.description: LIVE DEFECT (architect-diagnosed, Tron's screen): the lobby room-list ALTERNATES. Cause = TWO builders for one list. The WS 'welcome' send (server.ts:4930) uses the owner-UNAWARE builder roomManager.listRooms(getConnectedOwners()) AND fires PRE-AUTH (the session's playerToken is not yet known) -> it OMITS the session's PRIVATE OWNED rooms; every OTHER send (:5144, :5506) uses the owner-AWARE roomListFor(token) -> INCLUDES them. As the sends race, the owned room appears then disappears = the flap. FIX (architect): ONE builder — roomListFor(token) for ALL ROOM_LIST sends, emitted AFTER auth (:5183 where playerToken is set); the welcome sends NO competing ROOM_LIST.

discoverySource.verifiedBy: robbin-req (read server.ts:4930 owner-unaware pre-auth welcome + :5144/:5506 owner-aware roomListFor + :5183 auth; grep -a NUL-safe)
discoverySource.evidence: LIVE user-facing on Tron's screen (lobby room-list flap)

acceptanceCriteria.text: A session's PRIVATE OWNED room is PRESENT in EVERY room-list that session receives — the WELCOME/first list INCLUDED. No ROOM_LIST send a session gets ever omits its own private owned room.

gateRef.ref: test @390 owner sees own private room in welcome + all lists
gateRef.assertion: every ROOM_LIST a session receives (welcome first) contains its private owned room; any send that omits it => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a ROOM_LIST send to the owner that omits the owner's private room -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: BOTH DIRECTIONS: a NON-OWNER NEVER sees another user's private owned room in ANY room-list (the owner-aware builder must not leak).

gateRef.assertion: a non-owner's ROOM_LIST never contains another's private owned room; a leak => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a non-owner ROOM_LIST containing another user's private room -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Exactly ONE room-list builder — the owner-AWARE roomListFor(token) — feeds ALL ROOM_LIST sends. The owner-UNAWARE builder (roomManager.listRooms(getConnectedOwners())) is NOT used for any client ROOM_LIST send.

gateRef.assertion: every ROOM_LIST send uses roomListFor(token); any send building the list from getConnectedOwners (owner-unaware) => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a ROOM_LIST send built from the owner-unaware getConnectedOwners builder -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The ROOM_LIST is emitted AFTER auth (once playerToken is known, ~:5183), NOT pre-auth at welcome (:4930). The welcome message carries NO competing ROOM_LIST.

gateRef.ref: test welcome carries no ROOM_LIST; first list post-auth
gateRef.assertion: no ROOM_LIST is sent before auth; the welcome frame has no rooms; a pre-auth ROOM_LIST send => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a ROOM_LIST send in the welcome (pre-auth) frame -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Over N consecutive room-lists a session receives, the owned-room membership is STABLE — the private owned room does NOT alternate present/absent across sends (the flap is gone).

gateRef.ref: test N consecutive lists stable membership
gateRef.assertion: across N ROOM_LIST sends the owner's private room is present in ALL; present-then-absent alternation => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed two consecutive lists where the private room is present then absent -> RED
